subject: Urgent: late-stage capacity check & temporary hold for Orion Labs POC
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Carl Meyer <carl.meyer@orionlabs.com>
Cc: procurement@orionlabs.com
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: late-stage capacity check & temporary hold for Orion Labs POC

Team / Carl,

Orion Labs is in the final negotiation window for a dedicated-capacity POC and wants to sign next week. The ask is for a short-term dedicated pool so they can run integration + load testing before converting to a longer-term reserved contract. High-level requirements from their infra lead:
- Model: orion-xl-proxy (decoder-only, 70B)
- Expected steady QPS: ~18 inference requests/sec with 1.2k token average response (batching expected)
- Target latency SLO: p95 < 450ms for head requests
- Requested capacity: 8x H100-equivalent GPUs for an initial 6-week window (soft hold through end of June, final dates TBD)

I attached a quick capacity calc (capacity_calc_v2.xlsx) and a placeholder PO from Orion. Can infra inventory please confirm availability in us-west-2 (preferred) and whether we can place a short-term soft hold on 8 H100-class units starting ~2028-06-01? If H100s are constrained, provide alternative mixes (e.g., 10x A100 or 6x H100 + 2x burst).

As this is a revenue-triggered deal (DEAL-2398), sales needs a Yes/No on the hold by EOD Wed 2028-05-22 so we can commit timing to the customer. If there are obvious risks (conflicts with other committed reserves) call them out and suggest mitigations.

Carl — we'll coordinate billing details with procurement but want to lock the hardware path first.

Thanks,
Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: capacity_calc_v2.xlsx, po_placeholder_Orion_2398.pdf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Carl Meyer <carl.meyer@orionlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: late-stage capacity check & temporary hold for Orion Labs POC

Markus / team,

Quick inventory check summary (attached regional_inventory_snapshot.pdf):
- us-west-2 has 6x available H100-class nodes in the flexible pool for June; 4 of these are currently uncommitted, 2 are part of short-term standby allocations that can be released with approval.
- We have an additional 5x A100 nodes free across us-west-2/us-east-1 that could be used as a cross-region fallback (would add ~15-25ms network latency).

Options:
1) Soft hold 6x H100 now + 2x A100 as burst (lowest risk timeline, preserve most capacity)
2) Full hold 8x A100 in us-west-2 (cheaper but may not meet p95 SLO without tuning)
3) Suggest the customer adopt 4-bit quantization path for orion-xl-proxy — our internal tests (see sheet 'quant' in your attachment) indicate quantization could reduce GPU needs to ~5 H100-equivalents for the same throughput with some quality risk.

Operational notes:
- Soft holds are non-binding and will block allocation in the inventory system but do not reserve billing.
- We need sign-off from Finance if this becomes a billed provisional reserve.
- If Sales wants a hard dedicated reservation, lead time to convert to an actual Dedicated seat is ~10 business days for provisioning.

I'll tentatively place a soft hold for 6x H100 and open a ticket to evaluate borrowing 2x units from the standby pool, pending Lauren/Markus approval and confirmation on whether Orion will accept a mixed-A100 fallback.

Neha
Head of Capacity Planning

Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: late-stage capacity check & temporary hold for Orion Labs POC

Thanks Neha — that's helpful. A few clarifications from the customer side (Carl confirms below):
- Concurrency target: 20 concurrent streams during integration tests (spiky profile, steady-state lower)
- They are open to quantization if we can keep a small eval run in place; preference is H100 for initial test to avoid extra tuning work

Given that, please go ahead with the soft hold for 6x H100 and place a pending request to borrow 2x from the standby pool. Rishi / Aditya, please confirm we can enable passive KV cache and request routing that will reduce p95 pressure while Orion does integration.

Carl — we'll ask Finance for a provisional billing estimate, but Sales will need the soft-hold confirmation to keep the close timeline. I attached the placeholder PO so procurement can see the proposed window; we'll mark it as provisional.

Markus

Markus / Neha / team — update from infra ops: we placed a soft hold (non-billed) on 6x H100 in us-west-2 and submitted a borrow request for 2x H100 from the standby pool. Ticket created: INF-4218 (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4218).

Hold details:
- Hold ID: HOLD-9921
- Units: 6x H100 (soft) + borrow-pending 2x H100
- Hold window: 2028-06-01 through 2028-06-30 (auto-release unless converted to a paid reservation)
- Estimated provisional cost (6 weeks, list-rate): ~$38k USD (approx; Finance will provide official quote)

Next steps:
- Lauren / Markus: please reply-all to sign-off on the soft hold so we can notify Orion and update procurement.
- If Sales wants conversion to Dedicated (paid), we need a PO and 10 business days to provision; finance estimate will be provided by EOD Thu 2028-05-23.

I'll keep the ticket updated and will push for the borrow approval to secure the extra 2x H100.

Rishi
Head of Serving Runtime Ops
